tasks.analysis: Cosmology is the study of how the universe began, changed over time, and might evolve in the future. Scientists examine stars, planets, and galaxies using observations and models to describe cosmic events. One widely accepted idea is the big bang, which suggests the universe started from a single point and has been expanding ever since. Ongoing research helps improve our understanding of space, time, and the forces shaping the cosmos, revealing new discoveries about the vast universe. 宇宙学是研究宇宙如何起源、如何随时间演化以及未来可能如何发展的学科。科学家通过观测设备和模型来研究恒星、行星和星系，以此描述宇宙事件。一个被广泛接受的观点是 “大爆炸理论”，该理论认为宇宙始于一个单点，并从此不断膨胀。持续的研究有助于我们加深对空间、时间以及塑造宇宙的力的理解，并揭示了关于这一浩瀚宇宙的新发现。
